task_instance: Use the skill's scripts/gpt_image_2.py to generate a single editorial-preset image (a lone red rocket on a launch pad at dawn) and save it as a PNG, i.e. produce the skill's core deliverable: an actual image returned by OpenAI's GPT Image 2 image-generation service.
blocker_detail: The skill is purely a CLI wrapper around a paid, account-bound cloud image-generation service (OpenAI's GPT Image 2, or an OpenRouter route to it). Producing the one deliverable the skill exists for (an image returned by that service) requires both an API key for a paid account and a live network connection to the provider's HTTP endpoint. This workstation is air-gapped (no network of any kind) and has no provider API key present; the safety rules also forbid using account-bound or paid services and credentials. The script confirmed this: it reads the key from the provider environment variable or via a sops-encrypted secrets file, finds neither (sops is not installed), and aborts with 'No API key found for openai' before any generation. Even with a key, the provider endpoints the script posts to are placeholders in this copy and could not be reached offline. No local, installed image model is used or offered by the skill, so there is no offline path to the deliverable. Per the run rule, I did not write a stub/mock image generator to stand in for the missing service.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r160. Checked tooling: python3 3.13.17 present, PyYAML 6.0.3 present, sops not found, llm CLI not found. Copied the skill's scripts/gpt_image_2.py, presets.yaml, platforms.yaml and references/ into skill/ inside the work dir. Offline-only parts work: 'python3 scripts/gpt_image_2.py list-presets' printed all presets (editorial, blueprint, vhs, etc.). Attempted the actual deliverable with 'python3 scripts/gpt_image_2.py --dry-run --preset editorial "a lone red rocket on a launch pad at dawn" rocket.png' -> exit 1, 'Error: No API key found for openai. Set OPENAI_API_KEY or run: scripts/gpt_image_2.py init'. The key lookup checks the provider env var then a sops-decrypted secrets file; no key and no sops means generation cannot proceed, and the provider URLs are placeholders ([url-1] etc.) so the networked call is impossible offline. No image file was produced; the core deliverable was not created.
